children.text: Fresh, colorful, and packed with goodness! Our Acai Berry Bowl starts with a smooth, refreshing acai base and is topped with sweet strawberries, bananas, raspberries, crunchy chia seeds, toasted coconut, and a drizzle of honey.

Thick-cut cinnamon French toast layered with warm caramelized bananas and drizzled with a rich brown sugar-rum syrup. Finished with whipped cream and candied pecans, this Bananas Foster-inspired creation is the perfect combination of cozy comfort, indulgent sweetness, and unforgettable flavor. Served warm and made for savoring every bite.

Fuel your morning with a nutrient-packed breakfast designed to help you feel energized and satisfied. Our Superfoods Breakfast Bowl combines protein-rich scrambled eggs and creamy cottage cheese with fresh spinach, microgreens, juicy tomatoes, antioxidant-rich blueberries, creamy avocado, and crunchy sunflower seeds. Finished with a kiss of hot honey.  Packed with wholesome ingredients, plant-based nutrients, healthy fats, and lasting protein, it’s a fresh and flavorful way to power your day.
For a heartier version, swap spinach for kneaders breakfast potatoes

Start your day with a handcrafted breakfast built on our signature sourdough. This wholesome sandwich features fresh eggs, creamy Muenster cheese, grilled tomatoes, ripe avocado, and delicate microgreens layered together for the perfect balance of flavor, texture, and nourishment. Made with quality ingredients and bakery-crafted care, it’s a fresh, satisfying way to fuel your morning.

A fresh, elevated take on a breakfast classic, served on our artisan Asiago sourdough cheese bread. This hearty toast features creamy avocado, fluffy scrambled eggs, vibrant microgreens, and a flavorful pesto dressing, finished with a drizzle of pesto oil. Crafted with wholesome ingredients and layers of bakery-inspired flavor, it’s a satisfying way to start your day.

A comforting breakfast favorite made with hearty potatoes, vibrant red peppers, and savory red onions, all perfectly seasoned and cooked to golden perfection. Finished with a fresh sprinkle of green onions, this satisfying side brings delicious flavor and a farmhouse-inspired touch to any morning meal.
